voice: Blunt, overworked, and physically confident without repetitive pig-Latin shouting.

entries.text: Are you deaf? Read my lips: get out.
Can't a man get any privacy in his own office? I've got enough trouble already, so go bother somebody else.
Miss Bow, I've got enough trouble already. Unless you need something, please leave me alone.
This is a private office, Miss Bow. Please leave.
Oh, I'm sorry, Mr. Leach. I thought this was a storage room. I'll leave.
Miss Bow, I've warned you. This is my private office. Understand?
I was helping Olympia look for her ferret. Yes, that's it. Here, little ferret!
The ferret isn't here. Get out.
Miss Bow! Do I need to call security to throw you out?
